title: Partial rollout decision rhythm & KPI sentinels
content:
Purpose:
This working doc defines a compact decision rhythm and a set of KPI sentinels for partial/gradual rollouts (canary -> ramp -> broad). The goal is to give PMs, product-ops, SRE, and support a shared, lightweight checklist + tracker so we can make repeatable go/no-go decisions with clear rollback triggers and ownership.

Doc status and audience:
- Status: in_review (seeking inputs from eng-sre, product-hosted-api, and solutions-eng)
- Intended users: release conductor, oncall SRE, product ops lead, customer success rep for the cohort

Core principles (short):
1) Make decisions on high-signal, low-noise indicators (avoid token-level noise unless correlated).
2) Separate health sentinels (latency/error) from product-safety sentinels (quality/regressions).
3) Keep thresholds actionable and binary where possible (escalate / continue / rollback).
4) Bake in ownership at each decision gate so someone is accountable for the action.

Decision rhythm (templates):
- Gate 0: Canary uplift (0.1% traffic) — immediate validation window (0–30m)
  - Owners: deployment lead, canary SRE
  - Actions: smoke tests (API surface), sanity prompts, key customer probe requests
  - Decision: if any critical sentinel fires -> immediate rollback

- Gate 1: Early ramp (0.1% -> 1%) — observation window (30m–2h)
  - Owners: release conductor, product-ops
  - Decision cadence: check at 30m, 1h, 2h

- Gate 2: Progressive ramp (1% -> 10% -> 50%) — multi-window analysis (2h–24h)
  - Owners: product-ops + eng-sre + solutions-eng
  - Decision cadence: every ramp step has 1h quick-check and 6–24h stabilization check

KPI sentinels (definitions + example thresholds) — split into technical, economic, and quality buckets:
1) Technical health sentinels (primary triggers for rollback):
   - p95 latency (api/generate): baseline + 2x or absolute > 1.2s over baseline -> CRITICAL
   - error rate (5xx / request): > 0.5% sustained over 10m -> CRITICAL
   - downstream queue backlog (model inference queue): increase > 50% vs baseline -> WARN
   - infra OOM/eviction events: any occurrence -> CRITICAL

2) Economic sentinels (cost & unit economics):
   - per-request token cost delta vs baseline: > 20% increase without quality gain -> REVIEW
   - GPU slot saturation > 85% for > 30m -> WARN (consider throttling or fallback)

3) Product-quality sentinels (model/regression signals):
   - eval-prompt-set pass-rate: drop > 8 percentage points vs baseline on smoke set -> WARN
   - hallucination rate (measured by known fact-check probes): > 5% increase -> REVIEW
   - user-facing regression tickets (first response triage): > 3 SEV-2 within 1h -> CRITICAL

4) User-behavior sentinels (behavioral/leading indicators):
   - conversion funnel delta (feature-specific): > ±15% movement -> REVIEW
   - retention cohort variance after 24h: deviation > expected CI -> INVESTIGATE

Sentinel tiers and actions (decision map):
- CRITICAL: immediate rollback + incident bridge, pager escalation (SRE -> Englead -> PM)
- WARN: pause ramp, run extended diagnostics (30–60m), if unresolved -> rollback or degrade to safe variant
- REVIEW: product-ops + model-owner assessment within 2h, adjust prompts/config or continue with monitoring

Partial rollout matrix (quick reference):
- Traffic bands: 0.1%, 1%, 5%, 10%, 25%, 50%, 100%
- Gate window: 0-30m, 30m-2h, 2-6h, 6-24h, 24-72h
- Minimum sample: for quality signals require N>=500 requests or use statistical bootstrap if smaller

Operational tracker template (use as quick sheet during rollout):
- Run sheet columns (one-line CSV friendly):
  step_label, start_time_utc, traffic_pct, p95_latency_ms, error_rate_pct, queue_backlog_pct, cost_delta_pct, eval_pass_rate_pct, manual_notes, action_taken, owner_initials

Example row (text):
  G1-30m, 2026-02-12T14:30Z, 1, 420, 0.06, 12, 3.5, 94, "spike in p95 correlated with batch job", "paused ramp", "EK"

Canary scenarios and probes (keep a small set of deterministic probes for any rollout):
- Smoke prompt set: 12 prompts that exercise short/long contexts, safety, hard facts, structured output
- Failure probes: synthetic timeouts, auth-denied simulation, model-degraded-response probe (length+format)
- Customer probes: for targeted cohorts include 2–3 golden queries from early adopter customers (sanitized)

Go/No-Go checklist (pre-rollout, quick):
- [ ] Canary artifact built and verified (image checksum + model hash)
- [ ] Canary deck + run sheet shared to #release-control
- [ ] Oncall SRE & product-ops pagers staffed for next 6 hours
- [ ] Rollback playbook verified and tested in staging
- [ ] Key smoke prompts loaded and acceptance thresholds recorded
- [ ] Observability dashboards pinned (latency, errors, token cost, eval pass-rate)

Rollback decision playbook (one-liners):
- Immediate rollback: any CRITICAL sentinel -> run automated rollback script -> open incident bridge -> notify core stakeholders
- Soft degradation: if cost spike but quality stable -> switch routing to smaller model variant or enable KV-prefix cache for that traffic band
- Partial throttling: apply traffic partitioning to keep high-risk cohorts at previous model while others continue

Communication templates (for release conductor):
- Quick incident note (Slack): "[ROLLBACK] Canary 2026-02-12T14:XXZ triggered p95>1.2s. Automated rollback executed. Incident bridge up: #inc-release-2026-02-12. Owner: Priya Shah. ETA next update: +15m."
- Postmortem starter subject line: "PM: Canary rollback 2026-02-12 — preliminary timeline & regression signals"

Simulation checklist (recommend run before broad ramp):
- Synthetic load sim at expected 10x traffic for 30m in staging to validate autoscale behavior
- Injected slow model responses (200–500ms extra) to validate retries/backpressure handling
- Cost-probe: run representative prompts through billing simulator to check unit economics at scale

Open questions / follow-ups:
- Can we automate a gate for eval-pass-rate using the existing eval harness? (action: Lina Torres)
- Add lightweight A/B prompt-control toggle in the console for rapid rollback to previous prompt template? (action: Eng-Console)
- Define exact statistical test for "significant" drop in conversion funnel — product analytics to propose metric (JIRA-PRJ-887)

Appendix: quick links and attachments
- Confluence: /pages/partial-rollout-playbook (design doc)
- Dashboards: observability/dashboard/rollout-health
- Runbook: github.com/redwood-inference/runbooks/rollback-automations.md

Notes to reviewers (short):
This is intentionally compact — the org has many large playbooks; this one is a fast-check guide and tracker for small-to-medium rollouts where speed and clarity matter. Requesting: concrete thresholds from eng-sre for p95 bounds, and product analytics to vet the behavioral thresholds.

-- Priya
